title: Firm rule profiles for the fleet layer (engine/firms.py)
how_to_read: {"v": value, "verified": bool, "src": [...], "date": "yyyy-mm-dd", "n": note}:   verified true   the repo's research marks it confirmed: the firm's own help / plan page (read through web search), or the                   owner's own screenshots / receipts (MFFU). Re-check on the firm's site before money depends on it.   verified false  a third-party summary, a conflict between sources, or one source only.   v null          unknown: the value was assumed in research or not found. Never guessed here.   v "none"        the rule does not exist on that plan (e.g. no daily loss limit), per the sources. Prices: only the owner's real prices (MFFU); every other price is null ("check current codes before buying", CLAUDE.md).

bots.n: bots allowed when set to your own parameters, with oversight; HFT and sim-fill exploits banned

copy_trading.n: copying between your OWN accounts: not stated; mirroring 'for an unfair advantage' is banned; ask MFFU support in writing first

hedging.n: no long and short on the same underlying at the same time, also across your accounts

flat_by.n: flat by 16:10 ET (auto-liquidation); on CME half days you flatten yourself before the early halt

bots.n: automated systems and trade copiers permitted; HFT / microscalping banned
EAs / bots / AI allowed in the Challenge and the funded account (terms 2026-09-25)
Apex bans automated trading on all accounts (Sep 2026, third-party)
API bots on the Combine / XFA, banned on Live Funded; no VPS

ninjatrader.n: TopstepX only for new sign-ups (NinjaTrader not offered): this bot cannot route there today
NinjaTrader / Tradovate not offered for new accounts since 2026-07-12

price.n: the owner's real price with his MFFU code (list $153); one-time, $0 activation

dd_type.n: EOD trailing: moves only at the session close, up only; open losses count intraday

lock.n: the floor stops at start + $100 ($50,100)

dll.n: soft: trading paused for the rest of the session, the account stays open

max_minis.n: minis and micros count together (10 micros = 1 mini); orders above are auto-rejected

consistency.n: no best-day rule in the Builder eval

min_days.n: help guides: pass in as little as 1 trading day; the Builder plan page's table says 'min 2 days' (that row is about the first payout per another page). If the account is not marked passed after day 1, trade one small trade the next session.

news.n: Builder: news trading unrestricted in the eval and sim funded

lock.n: floor stops at +$100 above the start

buffer.n: $1,600 with the $1,500-MLL add-on; must be cleared before a request

max.n: per cycle

share.n: no share-of-profit cap: $500 - $2,000 a request

consistency.n: at payout time: the best day in the cycle <= 50% of the cycle's profit; not a breach, you just trade more days; resets after each approved payout

min_days.n: traded on at least 2 days in the current cycle; plan page says 'every 48 hours'

win_days.n: no winning-day count: 2 traded days a cycle

max_payouts.n: after the 5th approved sim payout you move to a live account (Blue Row Capital)

first_wait_days.n: first payout: >= $500 above the buffer and 48 hours after the first trade
